monitors.name: [Paymentswitch] Multipart cleanup error rate > 10%
monitors.message: @pagerduty-paymentswitch Multipart cleanup failure ratio exceeded 10% for 10 minutes. Inspect S3 permissions, object-storage availability, Redis/DB dependencies, and the cleanup CronJob logs. Runbook: https://runbooks.example.com/paymentswitch/multipart-cleanup

monitors.name: [Paymentswitch] Multipart cleanup abandoned backlog critical
monitors.message: @pagerduty-paymentswitch More than 100 expired multipart sessions remain abandoned for 15 minutes. S3 parts may be retained and KYC upload cleanup is degraded. Runbook: https://runbooks.example.com/paymentswitch/multipart-cleanup

monitors.name: [Paymentswitch] Multipart cleanup backlog growing
monitors.message: @slack-paymentswitch-oncall The abandoned multipart-session backlog is growing over 30 minutes. Check cleanup throughput, CronJob scheduling, database locks, and S3 abort latency. Runbook: https://runbooks.example.com/paymentswitch/multipart-cleanup
